allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add complete Medi-Warden app with enhancements

Features:
- Multi-profile medication tracking with SQLite
- Flexible scheduling \(daily/weekly/interval\)
- Notification system with strict/relaxed modes
- Adherence tracking and history

Recent enhancements:
- Home screen: medications sorted by intake time
- Home screen: Take and Skip buttons for in-app dose logging
- Indefinite stock option: skip stock tracking for some meds
- Stock info hidden throughout app for indefinite meds
- Android backup enabled for data persistence across updates

Database: v2 with isStockIndefinite migration
New icons and branding

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix notification and day boundary issues for medications

- Cancel notifications when medication is deactivated or deleted
- Reschedule notifications when medication is reactivated
- Extend dose search window to 12 hours before today to handle
  after-midnight actions for evening doses \(e.g., 9 PM dose taken
  at 00:05 AM now properly matches the previous day''s schedule\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
